derived.chamferAngleConvention: angle measured from the opening wall (insertion axis): run = depth * tan(angle)
derived.modelOrientation: both parts modeled with the chamfered lead-in at +Z top; flat show face on z=0 — print as exported, no supports
derived.cornerTreatment: wedge cutters overshoot the corners: slight corner relief, deliberate — eases the fit like a machinist's relief cut

formulas.insertWidth: insertWidth = openingWidth - 2 x clearance = 29.70mm; insertHeight = openingHeight - 2 x clearance = 19.70mm
